title: Open Hours
description: Guests can only sign in inside this schedule — outside it they see your closed message instead of the sign-in page. Anyone already online stays online until their session ends.
fixDays: Fix the highlighted days to save
loadErrorBanner: Could not load this location's saved open hours ({{error}}). Saving is turned off so the real schedule is not overwritten -- reload the page to try again.
timezoneMismatch: This schedule is enforced in {{venueZone}} — not your browser's {{browserZone}}. Times below are the venue's local time.

weekly.title: Weekly schedule
weekly.description: Tap a day to open it, then set when it starts and ends. Times are in {{zone}}.

dayErrors.missing: Set both an opening and a closing time, or mark the day closed.
dayErrors.order: Closing time must be after opening time. Overnight hours are not supported -- end at 23:59 and open the next day at 00:00.

guestExperience.title: Guest experience
guestExperience.description: What guests see, and how strictly the schedule above is enforced.

enforce.title: Enforce this schedule
enforce.description: Outside open hours, guests are shown the closed message below instead of the sign-in page.

closedMessageLabel: Message shown to guests while closed
